# MM-P3-L2-RR02 - Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2

Revision: Rev B
Plant: P3, line P3-L2
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-RR02

Scope
This document defines the preventive maintenance procedure for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02). The intent is to preserve machine integrity, prevent unplanned downtime, and maintain product quality through recurring inspection and service activities focused on the mandrel clamp and main roll bearing system. This manual supplements and references standard operating procedures and engineering change notices listed in Related Documents. Refer to ECN-2026-044 for recent engineering modifications and to SOP-P3-L2-01 and SOP-P3-L2-04 for operating and lockout procedures.

Tools
Basic mechanical service toolkit including torque wrench capable of the specified mandrel clamp bolt torque, spanners, impact-rated sockets, grease gun compatible with specified lubricant fittings, inspection mirror, flashlight, lint-free wipes, and calibrated vibration pickup if available. Use personal protective equipment consistent with plant standards and SOP-P3-L2-01.

Procedure
Background and rationale
Regular maintenance of the mandrel clamp and main roll bearings reduces risk of clamp slippage, mandrel runout, and bearing failure that can produce scrap rings or catastrophic equipment damage. The mandrel clamp bolt must be torqued to a validated value to maintain clamping force while avoiding fastener overstress. Main roll bearings require periodic lubrication to maintain an oil or grease film and to evacuate debris introduced during rolling.

Preparation
Follow SOP-P3-L2-01 for machine shutdown and electrical lockout. Verify that any changes in ECN-2026-044 have been implemented on the machine and that relevant schematics and fastener access points match the as-installed condition.

Mandrel clamp bolt torque
Clean the mandrel clamp bolt and mating thread area of any lubricant and debris using lint-free wipes. Inspect bolt for visible damage and the clamp assembly for deformation. If the bolt shows evidence of damage, tag it out and initiate replacement per plant parts procedures; do not re-use damaged hardware.

Set the calibrated torque wrench to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02), which is 475 N·m. Apply torque in a single continuous motion until the wrench indicates the set value. If a torque extension or adapter is used, compensate using a calibration chart for the tool; do not exceed the specified torque. Record the measured torque and tool serial identifier in the maintenance log.

If the clamp assembly uses multiple bolts, torque each bolt to the specified value using a radial or cross pattern to ensure uniform clamp load distribution. After completing torquing, run the mandrel at low speed per SOP-P3-L2-04 to seat the assembly and re-check torques after the first production shift.

Main roll bearing lubrication
Prior to lubrication, confirm the type of lubricant in use per lubricant data maintained in the lubrication register and any changes noted in ECN-2026-044. Clean grease fittings and surrounding areas to prevent contamination. Attach the grease gun and deliver lubricant until old grease is displaced from the bearing seals or until slight resistance indicates full charge, taking care not to overfill.

The main roll bearing lubrication interval for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 105 hours. Use this interval as the scheduling baseline for the lubrication program. Create a maintenance calendar entry keyed to machine run hours or production shifts as governed by the plant CMMS.

If vibration monitoring equipment is available, sample bearing vibration before and after lubrication to confirm reduction in bearing amplitude. Note any persistent increase in vibration or unusual noise; if present, follow escalation in this document.

Inspection and acceptance checks during procedure
Visually inspect seals and housings for leakage after lubrication. Verify that runout and axial play of the mandrel remain within acceptable limits as defined in SOP-P3-L2-04. If readings are out of tolerance, complete the corrective action path outlined in ECN-2026-044.

Examples and troubleshooting
Example condition: After torquing the mandrel clamp bolt to 475 N·m, the clamp shows a slight shift during the initial production run. Action: Stop the line per SOP-P3-L2-01, re-check bolt torque, inspect mating surfaces for wear or foreign material, and consult ECN-2026-044 for any design-specific guidance on clamp seating. If clamp seating cannot be achieved, tag for replacement.

Example condition: Main roll bearing shows elevated temperature or noise between scheduled lubrication events. Action: Schedule an immediate inspection, sample lubricant for contamination, grease-bearing per procedure, and increase monitoring frequency until stable. Document findings and notify maintenance supervision.

Records to keep
Record actual mandrel clamp bolt torque values, torque tool calibration identifier, technician name, and date in the equipment maintenance log. Record the main roll bearing lubrication action, lubricant type, lubricant batch if applicable, hours at time of service, and technician name. Store records consistent with plant record retention policy and reference them during audits or after encountering repeat failures.

Acceptance criteria
The equipment is acceptable for return to service when all of the following conditions are satisfied:
- The mandrel clamp bolt has been torqued to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02), which is 475 N·m, and recorded in the maintenance log.
- The main roll bearings have been lubricated and the action recorded; lubrication adheres to the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02), which is 105 hours.
- No visible leakage, excessive vibration, or abnormal noise persists after procedure completion. If any of these issues remain, escalate per SOP-P3-L2-01 and reference ECN-2026-044 for any corrective engineering instructions.

Related documents
ECN-2026-044
SOP-P3-L2-01
SOP-P3-L2-04

End of document.
